dynamic_import_policy.provenance: module constants, static expressions, bounded literal loops, or same-module literal callsites

capabilities.production_role: authentication, transport, adapter projection, supervision, and non-authoritative evidence plumbing
non-blocking receipts, metrics, and enrichment only; no decision authority

dependency_delta.review: The retired hook oracle paths are absent in this source tree. Native prompt, permission, package, and approval caller cutovers are still incomplete; do not publish this tree until their required regressions and installed routes pass.

rollback_boundary.scope: retired_modules only; the Python hook oracle has no packaged fallback
rollback_boundary.mechanism: revert the reviewed release as a unit; no packaged Python resident or oracle fallback

retired_modules.removal_reason: Codex CLI JSON trace parser that no entry point, workflow or contract reached; its own tests were the only importers.
Policy recipe validation helpers with no caller; the public recipe guide no longer claims a local validator.
Registrable-domain projection over the bundled PSL, orphaned with the publicsuffixlist dependency it wrapped.
Response helpers for legacy remote approvals that no approval path still called.
Resource budget and applied-control evidence scaffolding for an isolated-execution path that was never wired up.

Static-first sandbox runner for isolated script analysis that no production caller ever imported. guard-command's sandbox.rs carries the same shape but is itself unreferenced and leaves apply_resource_limits a no-op, so it is not named as a behavioural replacement.

Bounded declared-output capture for contained workspace execution that no production caller ever imported. The native contained-execution path captures only stdout.bin and stderr.bin from its own run directory under its own budgets, so it does not carry this module's declared-output walk and is not named as a behavioural replacement.
